headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / The Hindu / India Today
bullets_en: Unemployed youth raise ‘Rahul Gandhi go back’ slogans at Osmania University in Hyderabad.
BRS has raised questions over Revanth Reddy’s access to phone-tapping SIT probe details.
Literature is a vital tool to introduce culture and heritage to youth: Minister Ajay Singh.
BJP and Akali Dal in seat-sharing talks for 2027 Punjab polls, says reports.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad ki Osmania University mein berozgar nojawano ne 'Rahul Gandhi go back' ke naare lagaye.
BRS ne Revanth Reddy ki phone-tapping SIT tehqeeq ki tafseelat tak rasai par sawalaat utha diye.
Adab nojawanon tak saqafat aur virasat pohnchane ka ahem zariya hai: Minister Ajay Singh.
Reports ke mutabiq BJP aur Akali Dal 2027 ke Punjab polls ke liye seat-sharing par baat kar rahe hain.
